privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: ReWork is built so that you stay in control. We collect as little as possible, your employer never sees your personal activity, and you can delete everything with one button.
privacy.draft: Draft for the MVP pilot, written toward Japan's Act on the Protection of Personal Information (APPI). It will be reviewed by a lawyer before any real pilot.

purpose.body: To personalise information to your prefecture, language and work; to calculate take-home pay estimates; to answer your questions; and — only if you ask — to pass your transfer interest to your support organisation.

collected.body:
• Language, prefecture, town, industry, residence status, years in Japan (from onboarding)
• Job offers you type in or photograph — photos are read once and not stored
• Your chat messages with the assistant
• Anonymous monthly survey answers (stored without your user ID)
• Transfer-interest requests and buddy requests you send

whoSees.body: Your employer can NEVER see your chats, job offers, comparisons, transfer interest, individual survey answers, or whether you answered a survey. Employers and the prefecture only see group statistics, and only when at least 5 people are in the group. Your support organisation sees a transfer-interest request only after you press “Send”.

retention.body:
• Chat messages: 30 days, then deleted automatically
• Job-offer photos: not stored
• Survey answers: 24 months, never linked to you
• Transfer requests: until closed + 6 months
• Everything else: until you delete it

thirdParties.body: Anthropic (AI processing of offers and questions), Supabase (database and sign-in), Vercel (hosting). Data is sent to them only to provide ReWork. We never sell data and never share it with employers or job agencies.

rights.body: Every consent switch is off until you turn it on, and you can change it any time in Settings. “Delete all my data” in Settings removes everything linked to you immediately.

employer.title: Team wellbeing

employer.cantSee2: Workers' chats, pay comparisons or transfer plans
employer.cantSee3: Anything for a team with fewer than 5 answers
employer.kNote: Privacy rule: results appear only when 5 or more people answered (k = 5).

rule.q1: Hold a short 1-on-1 with each person about safety and how they're treated.
rule.q2: Fix shift schedules at least a week ahead and explain any changes.
rule.q3: Offer a weekly Japanese class or connect workers to the local Japanese salon.
rule.q4: Walk through a payslip together: each deduction and why.
rule.q5: Ask what would make next year better — and share one change you'll make.
rule.allGood: Scores look healthy. Keep checking in monthly.

employer.complianceBelow: {wage}/h in {place} is below the stored minimum of {min}/h.

pulse.title: Monthly check-in
pulse.lead: 1 = not at all, 5 = very much. Takes a minute.
pulse.privacy: Your answers are saved without your name or ID. Your workplace only sees team averages, and only when 5 or more people answered.

pulse.q2: My working hours and shifts are reasonable.
pulse.q3: I get enough help with Japanese and daily life.
pulse.q4: I understand my pay and deductions.
pulse.q5: I want to keep working here next year.
pulse.freeHint: Your workplace never sees this text — only an AI summary of everyone's comments, in Japanese, when 5+ people answered.

pulse.done: Thank you — your answer was counted anonymously.
pulse.already: You've already answered this month. Thank you!
pulse.noTeam: Your workplace hasn't joined the monthly check-in.
